name: Doki Doki: Encore!
source:
Doki Doki Encore! is a sequel, choice based mod that seeks to provide the player with a unique interactive experience by allowing them to make several consequential decisions that will affect their ending. The player has unlimited freedom in how they wish their story to be told, with the ability to switch between routes for extra excitement! With 5 days, 4 routes, 8 endings and 20 original soundtracks, you’ll be sure to find yourself locked in your seat for hours of gameplay as you dive deep to rejoin our favorite Literature Club!

The choices are yours to make, but every choice will have a consequence. Make your choice in Doki Doki Encore! Every good story deserves an encore!
translation:
心跳心跳安可！是一个续作，基于选择的模组，旨在通过允许玩家做出几个影响其结局的重要决定来为玩家提供独特的互动体验。玩家可以自由地选择如何讲述自己的故事，并且可以在路线之间切换以获得额外的刺激！5天、4条路线、8个结局和20首原创配乐，当你深入重新加入我们最喜爱的文学俱乐部时，你一定会发现自己被锁在座位上玩几个小时！

选择是你自己做出的，但每一个选择都会产生后果。在Doki Doki Encore中做出你的选择！每一个好故事都值得重演！
